Busy season has been kind to the desk
Aurelia Skyways pet travel bulletin

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is moving with care and urgency as more families trust Aurelia Skyways with cherished companions. Each case is handled from booking through pickup, with the passenger coordinator guiding required steps so no detail is missed. This steady work matters now more than ever, because a calm hand at the desk protects pets, reduces stress for travelers, and keeps every journey aligned with policy and welfare needs.

Staff should keep checking documents, crate readiness, and contact notes with sharp attention. When a traveler arrives worried, we must respond with clear guidance and firm reassurance. The desk is here to prevent avoidable delays and to support safe passage for every animal in our care. Please continue to treat each request as urgent, because a well-prepared departure begins with disciplined follow-through and ends with a welcome home that feels secure.
